scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic. A bundled script independently recomputes the cusp threshold, fold levels, three-root witness, residuals, active-region membership, and Jacobian signs. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result classifies regular endemic equilibria of the active-media subsystem and proves the middle branch is a saddle. It does not establish global bistability throughout the three-equilibrium wedge or classify Hopf bifurcations of the outer branches.

title: A universal cusp threshold for triple endemic equilibria in a media-responsive SIR model
